dimensions.name: budget_tier
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN budget < 1000000 THEN '1. Micro (<$1M)'
  WHEN budget < 15000000 THEN '2. Low ($1-15M)'
  WHEN budget < 75000000 THEN '3. Mid ($15-75M)'
  WHEN budget < 150000000 THEN '4. High ($75-150M)'
  ELSE '5. Blockbuster ($150M+)'
END
dimensions.comment: Five-tier budget segmentation for ROI analysis

dimensions.name: runtime_bucket
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN runtime_minutes < 90 THEN '1. Under 90 min'
  WHEN runtime_minutes < 120 THEN '2. 90-120 min'
  WHEN runtime_minutes < 150 THEN '3. 120-150 min'
  WHEN runtime_minutes < 180 THEN '4. 150-180 min'
  ELSE '5. 180+ min'
END

dimensions.name: language_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN original_language = 'en' THEN 'English'
  ELSE 'Non-English'
END
dimensions.comment: English vs Non-English classification for market analysis

dimensions.name: language_name
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN original_language = 'en' THEN 'English'
  WHEN original_language = 'fr' THEN 'French'
  WHEN original_language = 'ja' THEN 'Japanese'
  WHEN original_language = 'es' THEN 'Spanish'
  WHEN original_language = 'de' THEN 'German'
  WHEN original_language = 'it' THEN 'Italian'
  WHEN original_language = 'hi' THEN 'Hindi'
  WHEN original_language = 'ko' THEN 'Korean'
  WHEN original_language = 'tl' THEN 'Tagalog'
  ELSE 'Other'
END
dimensions.comment: Top 9 languages by full name, rest grouped as Other

datasets.name: hidden_gems
queryLines:
SELECT
  title,
  release_year,
  director_name,
  genre_list AS genres,
  original_language AS lang,
  budget,
  revenue,
  ROUND(budget / 1000000.0, 2) AS budget_m,
  ROUND(revenue / 1000000.0, 1) AS revenue_m,
  vote_average AS rating,
  vote_count AS votes
FROM
  employeedatacatalog.gold_movie.gold_movie_summary
WHERE
  budget BETWEEN 100000 AND 5000000
  AND vote_average >= 7.5
  AND vote_count >= 500
ORDER BY
  vote_average DESC

datasets.name: directors
queryLines:
SELECT
  director_name,
  movie_count,
  ROUND(total_revenue / 1e9, 2) AS total_revenue_b,
  ROUND(avg_revenue / 1e6, 1) AS avg_revenue_m,
  ROUND(avg_budget / 1e6, 1) AS avg_budget_m,
  ROUND(avg_profit / 1e6, 1) AS avg_profit_m,
  ROUND(avg_rating, 2) AS avg_rating,
  ROUND(avg_popularity, 1) AS avg_popularity,
  top_movie,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_rating DESC) AS rating_rank
FROM
  employeedatacatalog.gold_movie.gold_director_analytics
WHERE
  movie_count >= 5
